analyst.summary: Sagility India provides outsourced processing and technology services to US healthcare insurers and providers, and has grown revenue and profit strongly since its 2024 listing. Reported return ratios look modest mainly because of heavy non-cash amortization tied to the company's 2021 buyout structure, not because the underlying business is weak. The company's near-total reliance on the US healthcare market is the main risk to watch, but the growth and margin trends are genuinely encouraging.
